notes: §2002:11.9.3 GR4: a RECURSIVE program (and every program contained in it) may be called while active; any other program shall not be, and its CALL takes ON EXCEPTION or the 2002 ON OVERFLOW (§2002:14.8.4.3 GR3e, GR3g1).
